description: This file provides functions and types for formatting time durations into human-readable relative strings, including constants for time units, a struct for magnitude formatting, and functions for generating relative time descriptions.

classes.name: RelTimeMagnitude
classes.description: Struct defining how to format relative time durations based on magnitude, including the duration threshold, format string, and divisor for calculation.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Formats a given time into a relative string like '3 weeks ago'.

methods.name: RelTime
methods.description: Returns a relative time string between two times with labels, using default magnitudes.

methods.name: CustomRelTime
methods.description: Formats a relative time string between two times with custom magnitudes and labels.
